purpose: Provide a bounded operational binding when one task has multiple simultaneously valid immutable publication heads. This overlay preserves every publication as research evidence. It may select one publication for current runtime continuity, but that selection is not a truth, quality, priority, or canonical-mathematics judgment.
compatibility_note: The field name quarantined_publication_ids is retained only because the current compatibility reducer expects it. Semantically these IDs are RETAINED_PARALLEL_PUBLICATIONS: they remain immutable, reviewable, referenceable, and eligible for later KEEP_PARALLEL / MERGE / SPLIT / operational-reselection. Detailed historical reference-process metadata remains recoverable in Git history; this current router keeps only the live operational bindings and their decisive provenance.
